added_failures_note: baseline_suite 'logs/baseline-gate.txt' reports 96 passed; after_suite 'logs/gate.txt' reports 103 passed; both EXIT=0 per the reviewed manifest; zero added failures

findings.text: _vocabulary_definitions re-derives the physical-base and geometry-carrier token-to-definition map that imas_codex/standard_names/workers.py:8495 _closed_vocabulary_definitions already owns, using the same two loaders (load_physical_bases, load_geometry_carriers), so it duplicates rather than wraps the owner; it extends the capability only by adding the locus registry to the union.

the autouse fixture teardown calls ss._build_tree.cache_clear() before monkeypatch restores the original, so the base-offers-none and no-optional-none mutations (which replace _build_tree with a plain lambda) raise AttributeError at teardown for every test; the guard still fires, but each of those two mutation logs conjoins twelve ERROR entries with the real failure (logs/mutation-base-offers-none.txt reads '2 failed, 10 passed, 12 errors').

assert leaf.description == ss.option_text(leaf.key) compares the tree's own description, which _leaf_nodes built by calling option_text, against a fresh call to the same function, so both sides move together and the assertion cannot fail while option_text is deterministic; the load-bearing, independent guard is line 244 (assert leaf.description != leaf.key).

the done_when requires each guarded mechanism to fail with its mechanism removed '(log with EXIT=)', but none of logs/gate.txt, logs/baseline-gate.txt or the seven logs/mutation-*.txt carries an EXIT= line; each log ends at its pytest summary, so the sentinel the done_when names is absent from the stored evidence even though the pass/fail outcome is readable from the summary.
